display_name: Restart a dead or hung managed session (dispatch)
description: maintenance-verbs M1, D0.3-ratified deferred-completion shape. Dispatches a restart_session choreography job (capture the old ledger row's dispatch config, terminate_session, spawn_session under the same lane, drive an explicit role-reclaim turn unless a lane charter already covers it, then verify the fresh session actually claimed the target role) and returns {job_id, status: 'queued'} in milliseconds — the choreography itself runs in a background worker, never inline in this call. Poll check_choreography_job_status with the returned job_id for the outcome.
embedding_description: Recover a worker whose process is dead, hung, or unresponsive by killing it outright and spawning a brand-new process in the same lane, then driving the fresh process to reclaim the old one's durable role name — process-replacement recovery, never for a session that is merely full but still working fine (that is rotate_session's job).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: {job_id, status: 'queued'} — the dispatch's own outcome, NOT the restart's outcome.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State plainly that this only confirms the job was queued, not that the new session is up and holding the role — poll check_choreography_job_status for the real outcome, which reports old_agent_instance_id, new_agent_instance_id, role_reclaim_driven, and role_reclaim_verified once terminal.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Validates agent_instance_id/role_name/role_class plus the caller's own flow/session context, then writes one AsyncJobManager job row.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: a required field was empty (role_class is required from the caller because managed_session carries no role_class column of its own). missing_flow_context: the caller's session_id/flow_id were not resolvable — refused before a job with a hole in it could be created. job_creation_failed: AsyncJobManager.create_job itself failed. async_job_manager_unavailable: the platform's AsyncJobManager is not bound on this solet.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For missing_argument, read the dying session's own session_status first to confirm its lane_id/brief_ref before restarting, and supply the role_class it was originally spawned under. missing_flow_context and async_job_manager_unavailable are platform-state issues, not caller mistakes.
